title: Cheese wedge
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='cheeseTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ffcc33'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cheeseFront' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#f7b733'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e09b1f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cheeseSide' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffd95e'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f0b030'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- wedge body: triangular prism -->
  <polygon points='14,76 60,76 60,44' fill='url(#cheeseSide)'/>
  <polygon points='14,76 60,44 60,22' fill='url(#cheeseTop)'/>
  <polygon points='14,76 60,76 60,44' fill='url(#cheeseFront)' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- top face highlight edge -->
  <polygon points='14,76 60,44 60,22' fill='none' stroke='#fff3b0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- front face lighter edge -->
  <polygon points='14,76 60,76 60,44' fill='none' stroke='#ffcf5c' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- holes on front face -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='64' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#c9821a'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='64' rx='6' ry='5' fill='none' stroke='#a86a12' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='4' ry='3.5' fill='#c9821a'/>
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='72' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#c9821a'/>

  <!-- holes on top face -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='62' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#d99423' transform='rotate(-25 28 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='52' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#d99423' transform='rotate(-25 42 52)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#d99423' transform='rotate(-25 50 44)'/>

  <!-- shiny highlight on top -->
  <polygon points='22,70 34,62 44,52 38,50 26,60 18,68' fill='#fff6c2' opacity='0.55'/>
</svg>
